projections.label: PROJECTION - not actual results
assumptions: The 3,000,000 seed round closes in December 2026 (target close 16 Dec 2026); the advance subscription converts at the same time and brings no new cash.
Licensed seats grow from 73,000 to 158,334 by December 2027 (ARR 1,900,008), mostly through expansion at existing trusts and councils and about one new organisation a month.
Price stays at 12 per user per year (1.00 per seat per month); deployment fees of 7,500 to 8,500 per new organisation.
Planned net burn of about 140,000 a month after the raise as the deployment team grows.
Revenue is collected in the month billed for projection purposes.

knownDiscrepancies.accountsStatement: Gross margin in the management accounts for the 12 months to October 2026 is 29.3%; licence gross margin (licence revenue less hosting, authenticator services and support tooling) is 82.0%.
knownDiscrepancies.reason: The deck quotes licence gross margin. The management accounts put the deployment team's payroll in cost of sales, and deployment fees do not cover it yet.

knownDiscrepancies.deckStatement: Net burn today about 70,000 a month; cash 480,000 at 30 Sep 2026; runway 6.9 months.
knownDiscrepancies.accountsStatement: October 2026 net burn 92,340 and cash 388,070 at 31 Oct 2026: runway 4.2 months at the October burn.
knownDiscrepancies.reason: The deck uses September 2026. October adds two deployment engineers (headcount 21 to 23) and a recruitment fee (4,500), and no deployment-fee receipts arrived in October (September received 14,000).

knownDiscrepancies.accountsStatement: An advance subscription of 1,500,000 was received on 18 Jul 2025 and converts at the seed round.
knownDiscrepancies.reason: The 6 Oct seed profile lists only the 2023 pre-seed, which cannot fund the costs to the stated September cash. The advance subscription is not yet shares, so the current cap table is unchanged; it appears in the pro forma.
